description: Use when a specific company and website are known. Returns explainable FIT / NEED / NOW opportunity intelligence and saves the analysis as an AGENT / API history source.

address.description: Optional postal or street address used to disambiguate the company.
address.title: Address

company_name.description: Official or commonly used company name to analyze.
company_name.title: Company Name

country.description: Company country or market. Use DACH when the exact DACH country is not yet known.
country.title: Country

district.description: Optional district, county or local administrative area of the company.
district.title: District

google_place_id.description: Optional Google Place ID when already known for more precise company matching.
google_place_id.title: Google Place Id

industry.description: Optional company industry or business category used to improve analysis context.
industry.title: Industry

language.description: Human-readable analysis output language: de, en, es or fr.
language.title: Language

region.description: Optional state, province, canton or regional area of the company.
region.title: Region

website.description: Company website URL, preferably including https:// when known.
website.title: Website

name: analyze_company
title: Analyze company opportunity
